lemma DERIV_nonneg_imp_nondecreasing:
  fixes a b :: real
    and f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "a \<le> b"
    and "\<And>x. \<lbrakk>a \<le> x; x \<le> b\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>y. DERIV f x :> y \<and> y \<ge> 0"
  shows "f a \<le> f b"
proof (rule ccontr, cases "a = b")
  assume "\<not> ?thesis" and "a = b"
  then show False by auto
next
  assume *: "\<not> ?thesis"
  assume "a \<noteq> b"
  with \<open>a \<le> b\<close> have "a < b"
lemma DERIV_nonpos_imp_nonincreasing:
  fixes a b :: real
    and f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "a \<le> b"
    and "\<And>x. \<lbrakk>a \<le> x; x \<le> b\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>y. DERIV f x :> y \<and> y \<le> 0"
  shows "f a \<ge> f b"
proof -
  have "(\<lambda>x. -f x) a \<le> (\<lambda>x. -f x) b"
    using DERIV_nonneg_imp_nondecreasing [of a b "\<lambda>x. -f x"] assms DERIV_minus by fastforce

theory Real_Peak
  imports Complex_Main
begin

(* k(t) = sin t - t cos t has derivative t sin t >= 0 on [0, pi], so k >= 0 there. *)
lemma sin_ge_x_cos:
  assumes "0 \<le> x" "x \<le> pi"
  shows "x * cos x \<le> sin x"
proof -
  have d: "\<And>t. DERIV (\<lambda>t. sin t - t * cos t) t :> cos t - (1 * cos t + t * (- sin t))"
    by (intro DERIV_diff DERIV_sin DERIV_mult DERIV_ident DERIV_cos)
  have mono: "(\<lambda>t. sin t - t * cos t) 0 \<le> (\<lambda>t. sin t - t * cos t) x"
  proof (rule DERIV_nonneg_imp_nondecreasing[OF assms(1)])
    fix t assume "0 \<le> t" "t \<le> x"
    have "t \<le> pi" using \<open>t \<le> x\<close> assms(2) by linarith
    have s: "0 \<le> sin t" using \<open>0 \<le> t\<close> \<open>t \<le> pi\<close> sin_ge_zero by blast
    show "\<exists>y. DERIV (\<lambda>t. sin t - t * cos t) t :> y \<and> 0 \<le> y"
      apply (rule exI[where x="cos t - (1 * cos t + t * (- sin t))"])
      using d[of t] \<open>0 \<le> t\<close> s by (auto simp: algebra_simps)
  qed
  then show ?thesis by simp
qed

(* Jordan-type bound: sin x / x is nonincreasing on (0, pi/2] and equals 2/pi at pi/2. *)
lemma jordan_sin:
  assumes "0 \<le> x" "x \<le> pi/2"
  shows "2 * x / pi \<le> sin x"
proof (cases "x = 0")
  case True
  then show ?thesis by simp
next
  case False
  then have xpos: "0 < x" using assms(1) by simp
  have hpi: "0 < pi" by simp
  have der: "\<And>y. 0 < y \<Longrightarrow> DERIV (\<lambda>t. sin t / t) y :> (cos y * y - sin y * 1) / y^2"
    using DERIV_divide[OF DERIV_sin DERIV_ident] by (simp add: power2_eq_square)
  have mono: "(\<lambda>t. sin t / t) (pi/2) \<le> (\<lambda>t. sin t / t) x"
  proof (rule DERIV_nonpos_imp_nonincreasing[OF assms(2)])
    fix y assume hy: "x \<le> y" "y \<le> pi/2"
    then have ypos: "0 < y" using xpos by linarith
    have yle: "y \<le> pi" using hy(2) hpi by linarith
    have kc: "y * cos y \<le> sin y" using sin_ge_x_cos[of y] ypos yle by linarith
    show "\<exists>d. DERIV (\<lambda>t. sin t / t) y :> d \<and> d \<le> 0"
    proof (intro exI conjI)
      show "DERIV (\<lambda>t. sin t / t) y :> (cos y * y - sin y * 1) / y^2" using der[OF ypos] .
      have "cos y * y - sin y * 1 \<le> 0" using kc by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      moreover have "0 < y^2" using ypos by simp
      ultimately show "(cos y * y - sin y * 1) / y^2 \<le> 0" by (rule divide_nonpos_pos)
    qed
  qed
  have g_pi: "(\<lambda>t. sin t / t) (pi/2) = 2 / pi" by (simp add: field_simps)
  have ineq: "2 / pi \<le> sin x / x" using mono g_pi by simp
  have e: "sin x / x * x = sin x" using xpos by simp
  have "2 / pi * x \<le> sin x / x * x" by (rule mult_right_mono[OF ineq]) (use xpos in linarith)
  then show ?thesis using e by (simp add: field_simps)
qed

lemma sin_div_lower:
  assumes "0 < t" "t \<le> pi * q / 2" "0 < q" "q < 2"
  shows "2 / pi * min 1 ((2 - q) / q) \<le> sin t / t"
proof (cases "t \<le> pi/2")
  case True
  have hpi: "0 < pi" by simp
  have j: "2 * t / pi \<le> sin t" using jordan_sin[of t] assms(1) True by simp
  have h1: "2 / pi * t \<le> sin t" using j by (simp add: field_simps)
  have h2: "2 / pi \<le> sin t / t"
    using h1 assms(1) by (simp add: pos_le_divide_eq)
  have m1: "min 1 ((2 - q) / q) \<le> 1" by simp
  have "2 / pi * min 1 ((2 - q) / q) \<le> 2 / pi * 1"
    by (rule mult_left_mono[OF m1]) simp
  then show ?thesis using h2 by simp
next
  case False
  have hpi: "0 < pi" by simp
  have tpi: "t < pi"
  proof -
    have "t \<le> pi * q / 2" using assms(2) by simp
    moreover have "pi * q / 2 < pi" using hpi assms(4) by simp
    ultimately show ?thesis by linarith
  qed
  have ht_half: "pi/2 < t" using False by simp
  have s_nonneg: "0 \<le> pi - t" using tpi by linarith
  have s_le: "pi - t \<le> pi/2" using ht_half by linarith
  have j: "2 * (pi - t) / pi \<le> sin (pi - t)" using jordan_sin[of "pi - t"] s_nonneg s_le by simp
  have sin_eq: "sin (pi - t) = sin t" by (simp add: sin_diff)
  have hm: "min 1 ((2 - q) / q) \<le> (pi - t) / t"
  proof -
    have "min 1 ((2 - q) / q) \<le> (2 - q) / q" by simp
    also have "(2 - q) / q \<le> (pi - t) / t"
    proof -
      have "(pi - t) / t - (2 - q) / q = (q * pi - 2 * t) / (q * t)"
        using assms(3) assms(1) by (simp add: field_simps)
      moreover have "0 \<le> (q * pi - 2 * t) / (q * t)"
        using assms(2) assms(3) assms(1) by (intro divide_nonneg_nonneg) (nlinarith, nlinarith)
      ultimately show ?thesis by linarith
    qed
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have "2 / pi * min 1 ((2 - q) / q) \<le> 2 / pi * ((pi - t) / t)"
    by (rule mult_left_mono[OF hm]) (use hpi in simp)
  also have "2 / pi * ((pi - t) / t) = (2 * (pi - t) / pi) / t"
    using hpi assms(1) by (simp add: field_simps)
  also have "\<dots> \<le> sin t / t"
    by (rule divide_right_mono) (use j sin_eq assms(1) in auto)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma peak_real:
  assumes "0 < rho" "rho < 1" "1 - rho \<le> q" "q \<le> 1 + rho"
  shows "(1 - rho)^3 \<le> q * (min 1 ((2 - q) / q))^2"
proof (cases "q \<le> 1")
  case True
  have qpos: "0 < q" using assms(2,3) by linarith
  have m: "min 1 ((2 - q) / q) = 1"
  proof -
    have "1 \<le> (2 - q) / q" using True qpos by (simp add: field_simps)
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
  have "(1 - rho)^3 \<le> q"
  proof -
    have a: "0 \<le> 1 - rho" using assms(2) by linarith
    have b: "1 - rho \<le> 1" using assms(1) by linarith
    have "(1 - rho)^3 \<le> (1 - rho)^1"
      using a b by (rule power_decreasing) simp_all
    then show ?thesis using assms(3) by simp
  qed
  then show ?thesis using m by simp
next
  case False
  then have q1: "1 < q" by simp
  have qpos: "0 < q" using q1 by linarith
  have m: "min 1 ((2 - q) / q) = (2 - q) / q"
  proof -
    have "(2 - q) / q \<le> 1" using q1 qpos by (simp add: field_simps)
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
  have rhs: "q * ((2 - q) / q)^2 = (2 - q)^2 / q"
    using qpos by (simp add: field_simps power2_eq_square)
  have key: "(1 - rho)^3 * q \<le> (2 - q)^2"
  proof -
    have a: "0 \<le> 1 - rho" using assms(2) by linarith
    have s: "(1 - rho)^3 * q \<le> (1 - rho)^3 * (1 + rho)"
      using assms(4) a by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    have t: "(1 - rho)^3 * (1 + rho) \<le> (1 - rho)^2"
    proof -
      have "(1 - rho)^3 * (1 + rho) = (1 - rho)^2 * (1 - rho^2)" by (simp add: algebra_simps power2_eq_square power3_eq_cube)
      moreover have "0 \<le> (1 - rho)^2" by simp
      moreover have "1 - rho^2 \<le> 1" using assms(1) by simp
      ultimately show ?thesis using mult_left_mono[of "1 - rho^2" 1 "(1-rho)^2"] by simp
    qed
    have u: "(1 - rho)^2 \<le> (2 - q)^2"

    show ?thesis using s t u by linarith

(* Jordan-type bound: sin x / x is nonincreasing on (0, pi/2] and equals 2/pi at pi/2. *)
lemma jordan_sin:
  assumes "0 \<le> x" "x \<le> pi/2"
  shows "2 * x / pi \<le> sin x"
proof (cases "x = 0")
  case True
  then show ?thesis by simp
next
  case False
  then have xpos: "0 < x" using assms(1) by simp
  have hpi: "0 < pi" by simp
  have der: "\<And>y. 0 < y \<Longrightarrow> DERIV (\<lambda>t. sin t / t) y :> (cos y * y - sin y * 1) / (y * y)"
    by (rule DERIV_divide[OF DERIV_sin DERIV_ident]) simp
  have mono: "(\<lambda>t. sin t / t) (pi/2) \<le> (\<lambda>t. sin t / t) x"
  proof (rule DERIV_nonpos_imp_nonincreasing[OF assms(2)])
    fix y assume hy: "x \<le> y" "y \<le> pi/2"
    then have ypos: "0 < y" using xpos by linarith
    have yle: "y \<le> pi" using hy(2) hpi by linarith
    have kc: "y * cos y \<le> sin y" using sin_ge_x_cos[of y] ypos yle by linarith
    have num: "cos y * y - sin y * 1 \<le> 0" using kc by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    have den: "0 < y * y" using ypos by (rule mult_pos_pos[OF _ ypos]) simp
    have "(cos y * y - sin y * 1) / (y * y) \<le> 0"
      by (rule divide_nonpos_pos[OF num den])
    then show "\<exists>d. DERIV (\<lambda>t. sin t / t) y :> d \<and> d \<le> 0"
      using der[OF ypos] by blast
  qed
  have g_pi: "(\<lambda>t. sin t / t) (pi/2) = 2 / pi" by (simp add: field_simps)
  have ineq: "2 / pi \<le> sin x / x" using mono g_pi by simp
  have e: "sin x / x * x = sin x" using xpos by simp
  have "2 / pi * x \<le> sin x / x * x" by (rule mult_right_mono[OF ineq]) (use xpos in linarith)
  then show ?thesis using e by (simp add: field_simps)
qed

lemma sin_div_lower:
  assumes "0 < t" "t \<le> pi * q / 2" "0 < q" "q < 2"

    using h1 assms(1) by (simp add: pos_le_divide_eq)

  have "2 / pi * min 1 ((2 - q) / q) \<le> 2 / pi * 1"
    by (rule mult_left_mono[OF m1]) simp
  then show ?thesis using h2 by simp
next

  have hpi: "0 < pi" by simp
  have tpi: "t < pi"
  proof -

  have s_nonneg: "0 \<le> pi - t" using tpi by linarith
  have s_le: "pi - t \<le> pi/2" using ht_half by linarith
  have j: "2 * (pi - t) / pi \<le> sin (pi - t)" using jordan_sin[of "pi - t"] s_nonneg s_le by simp

  have qne: "q \<noteq> 0" using assms(3) by simp
  have hm: "min 1 ((2 - q) / q) \<le> (pi - t) / t"
